# 🔎 Level 4

Your first hunt begins now!

Locate the place shown in the image below. Once you've found it **in-game**, take a screenshot with **your truck** clearly visible and the location in the background.

## Rules
• The **first** valid submission in this channel wins.
• Your screenshot must clearly show both your truck and the matching location.
• Edited or fake images will be disqualified.

## 🏆 Reward
**70,000 Server Economy**

If nobody finds the location, we'll post a **hint** at <t:1785166200:F> (one hour before the location is revealed and the next hunt begins).

Good luck, and happy hunting! 🚛
-# If you can't message in this channel, scroll up and click participate.
